description: Observes public documents without modifying their source. Execution can charge USDC or prepaid credits, consume trial quota and update Fresh402 records. A new charge requires prior spending authorization. Without billing/trial credentials, a valid call returns an unpaid quote without executing the observation. Use for bounded directional OpenAPI3.0/3.1 JSON contract-change evidence, including supported paths/operations, required fields, types/enums/null and authentication. Requires real watch_id from free unfiltered registration; no URL override. compare_to: previous(default) or baseline; previous_hash overrides with supported retained evidence. First call seeds contract history. No YAML, external-reference fetch or endpoint execution; uncertainty requires review, not a complete compatibility proof. Save watch IDs; local oasdiff may suit larger contracts. $0.020 USDC/call on Base (eip155:8453), including cache hits. Needs an x402-capable MCP payment client and funded native-USDC payer; ordinary MCP returns a payment challenge. Optional MPP (root mpp_payments.enabled): mppx, org.paymentauth/credential. Prepaid: X-Fresh402-API-Key plus params._meta["fresh402/prepaid"] {idempotency_key,tariff_version,max_credits}; inspect authenticated quote. Choose one billing method; never auto-pay. Persist original proof/input/private recovery token; recover originals after uncertainty. Circle only if root circle_gateway.enabled. Clients, limits and recovery: https://fresh402.com/docs#payments. Free signed trial: /v3/agent-trial requires an unfunded EOA ownership signature; human Web trial: /v2/trial. Eligibility/capacity may return429. Use only X-Fresh402-Trial-Key plus persisted Idempotency-Key; replay exact tool/input/key. Exhaustion never authorizes a charge.

inputSchema.description: Compare a registered, unfiltered public JSON OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 contract; watch_id is required, compare_to defaults to previous, and optional previous_hash overrides it. Bounded structural analysis, not a complete compatibility proof; no YAML, external reference fetching or execution of described API operations. Unknown fields are rejected.

compare_to.description: Optional mode: 'previous' (default) compares with the latest saved OpenAPI Contract Diff snapshot; 'baseline' uses its fixed saved baseline. Before contract history exists, the current registered watch state seeds the initial baseline. previous_hash overrides the mode. 'hash' appears only in results, not as an accepted input mode.

previous_hash.description: Optional 64-character hexadecimal reference hash, case-insensitive. Prefer a hash returned by OpenAPI Contract Diff for this same watch, matching a retained contract snapshot or fixed baseline. The current registered core hash is also accepted as a fallback: without a matching contract snapshot, the fixed baseline (or registered state if no baseline exists) is used. Overrides compare_to; unavailable hashes return 404. Omit to use the selected mode.

watch_id.description: Required existing watch ID: 'w_' plus 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Obtain it with free fresh402_register or POST /v1/register using the public JSON OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 URL and no selector or ignore rules. Reuses the saved URL; do not pass url here. YAML, non-OpenAPI documents and scoped/filtered watches are unsupported. Illustrative IDs must be replaced.
